evals.prompt: Implement a macOS-style settings panel with shadcn/ui and Radix UI adhering to Apple HIG.
evals.expected_output: Accessible component code following Apple Human Interface Guidelines with HIG spacing, touch targets, and tokens.
expectations: Selects Apple HIG specification based on platform decision tree
Uses headless component architecture (shadcn/ui or Radix primitives)
Adheres to HIG touch target requirements (min 44x44 pt)
Includes accessible attributes (aria-label, focus rings, disabled states)

evals.prompt: Create an Android Material 3 confirmation dialog with primary and secondary actions.
evals.expected_output: Material 3 compliant confirmation dialog specification with elevation tokens and accessibility states.
expectations: Maps components to Material definitions (Dialog, Button, Surface)
Enforces Material 3 corner radius (e.g. 28dp for dialog containers)
Implements proper tonal elevation and color roles (Primary, SurfaceVariant, OnSurface)
Includes full state definitions (focus, hover, active, pressed)
